capabilities: Scan the vault for orphaned notes and attachments
Preview and confirm orphaned files before deletion
Move deleted files to a custom trash folder
Schedule automatic cleanup of orphaned attachments
Configure whitelists, regex ignore patterns, and protection periods
extras: Auto-cleanup only deletes attachments, never notes; permanent delete is offered as a dangerous option with custom trash as the default.
intentEvidence: This plugin is a fork of nuke-orphans-plugin, enhanced with a visual dashboard, scheduled auto-cleanup
problem: Obsidian leaves orphaned notes and unreferenced attachments in the vault with no built-in way to find and safely clean them up.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of nuke-orphans-plugin, enhanced with a visual dashboard

summary: Vault cleanup dashboard that scans for orphaned notes and attachments, previews them, and deletes them with scheduled auto-cleanup and file protection.
